title: Only classified vision output creates a non-confirmed trust record

given.handoff: matching immutable vision envelope and structured candidate for the same active Plant

when.action: persist the candidate through the Plant State service

then.high_confidence_observation: present or absent finding at confidence 0.50 or above starts observed
then.low_confidence_or_uncertain: finding below 0.50 or uncertain starts unknown regardless of the pending envelope candidate claim
then.confirmation: no agent-created record starts confirmed and pending or unsafe classification writes nothing
